bodies.name: Mercury

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.description: A rocky planet with a thick atmosphere and extremely hot surface.
bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Roman goddess of love and beauty.

bodies.name: Mars
bodies.description: A rocky planet often called the Red Planet.

bodies.name: Jupiter

bodies.name: Saturn
bodies.description: A gas giant known for its bright ring system.

bodies.name: Uranus

bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Greek god of the sky.

bodies.name: Neptune

bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Roman god of the sea.

bodies.name: Ceres

bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Roman goddess of agriculture.

bodies.name: Pluto

bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Roman god of the underworld.

bodies.name: Haumea

bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Hawaiian goddess of fertility and childbirth.

bodies.name: Makemake

bodies.name: Eris

bodies.nameOrigin: Named for the Greek goddess of discord.
